snapshot.active_task: CORE-008-T04: Implement settlement and reconciliation lifecycle.

purpose: One persistent source-level audit record for ACRL as the continuity/reconstruction/recovery/governance plane of the whole HOMIO real-estate platform, including repository-wide frontend impact analysis. Includes safe GitHub 403/404 recovery and fast resume/incremental audit after screen or chat switches.

authority_and_boundaries.execution_authority: REOS_CONTROL_CENTER/data/state.json and existing Control Center workflow remain authoritative.
this_file_does_not_authorize: Implementing outside the currently authorized task
Bypassing repository permissions, branch protection, rulesets or the guarded PowerShell/GitHub workflow
Claiming tests/CI passed without exact current SHA and evidence
authority_and_boundaries.frontend_boundary: ACRL can statically analyze frontend source as repository tooling. The Next.js frontend must not import ACRL/AUTONOMY_ENGINE runtime modules or read state.json as live frontend runtime data.
authority_and_boundaries.single_source_rules: Do not create a second ACRL, state store, source classifier, dependency graph, identity engine, research engine or chat memory engine. Reuse T07/T14/T16/T18/T21/T23/T24/T25 existing responsibilities.
authority_and_boundaries.403_404_boundary: Authorized workflow recovery only; no permission/access-control bypass.
authority_and_boundaries.resume_manifest_boundary: Manifest is a derived cache, never execution authority. Validate live HEAD and state.json first.
authority_and_boundaries.screen_latency_boundary: Reduces repeated repository reads/context reconstruction. Does not control ChatGPT UI rendering, browser navigation latency or model service latency.
authority_and_boundaries.method: Static source/config review plus official GitHub documentation research. Test-file existence is not runtime proof.

executive_summary.assessment: ACRL is already large (observed 621 files, 31 tree entries including two T14-named directories). Do not rebuild it. Fix P0 read-only/authority/continuity/evidence defects, harden stateful authorization and result identity, make T16/T17/T20 HOMIO frontend-aware, improve CI, add safe GitHub API error recovery, and avoid repeat full audits on every continuation.

It allows and runs the checkpoint mutation against canonical state.json despite read-only integration contracts.

findings.title: T23 requested evidence IDs and canonicality are not strictly enforced
evidence: Requested IDs are checked for existence but candidate selection is not restricted to those IDs.

evidence: When project_context is empty, coordinator can copy expected fingerprints/branch/commit from the request itself and still recover.

update() can replace reservations without full ID/numeric/capacity validation.
isinstance(x,int) admits bool.
done: Reject negative/bool/invalid and over-capacity values where disallowed.

findings.title: T18 approval provenance must bind to trusted authentication
evidence: Human approval checks flags/IDs/authority/evidence/scope fingerprint but the validation path does not visibly bind principal to trusted OIDC/authentication proof.

Missing/untrusted proof fails closed; do not create a second identity engine.

findings.title: T29 expiry, nonce replay and store-owned atomic transitions
evidence: DecisionPolicy max_decision_age/allow_expiration are declared but not applied by the gate.
Decision validation checks non-negative timestamp but not age.
Controller directly mutates store._items outside a store-owned lock/transition API.

evidence: T16 parser/dependency graph and T17 impact resolution primarily cover .py/.pyi.
Two SourceClassifier implementations create inconsistent classifications.

findings.title: EntryPoint must separate local repo readiness, remote proof, state authority and bootstrap
evidence: git_preflight covers cwd/root/branch/origin/HEAD/T21 path but not enough separation of dirty/ahead/behind and live remote-tip proof.
No dedicated AI_AGENT_ENTRYPOINT contract test was found; existing test folder is spelled tets.
done: Distinguish local dirty/ahead/behind, approved remote readback, canonical state/authorization and ACRL bootstrap.
Use existing tets folder; bootstrap is not a second authority.

findings.title: Backend CI does not run the full ACRL suite
evidence: .github/workflows/backend-ci.yml compiles selected Control Center/context/T21 files and tests selected sync/auth/finance/T21/L3/phase/identity areas, not the full ACRL tree.
done: Preserve every existing check.
Add compileall and full ACRL pytest coverage plus tets/test_ai_agent_entrypoint_contract.py.
Report pass only for exact SHA/run URL.

findings.title: GitHub API 403/404 needs safe classified recovery, not blind retries
evidence: This session’s create-file request failed with 403 Resource not accessible by integration while reads worked; this proves only the connected write integration lacked access.
GitHub documentation says private resources may return 404 when auth/access is missing, and integration 403 indicates permission mismatch; Contents writes require the appropriate write permission.
done: Typed status distinguishes permission denial, rate limit, policy block, ambiguous/confirmed 404, stale SHA, transient failure and user recovery required.
No authorization-denial retries, guessed path sweeps or silent default-branch fallback.
Writes serialized; verify content/commit readback before SAVED.
Never log credentials or use unapproved alternate credentials.
findings.security_boundary: This is workflow recovery, NOT an access-control bypass. ACRL must not bypass GitHub identity, app permissions, repository access, branch protection, rulesets or rate limits.
findings.notes: Full recovery matrix is in the top-level github_api_recovery_policy field.

findings.title: Fast resume and incremental audit to reduce repeated research/read work on screen/chat switch
evidence: User reports research/read audits take too long after switching screens/chats; this is a stated workflow issue, not measured latency.
Existing T07, T14, T16, T23, T24 and T25 should compose the solution; do not create a second memory/search/graph/state engine.
done: Unchanged valid manifest avoids full ACRL scan.
A changed file invalidates that file and affected dependents, not the entire tree.
state.json or authority mismatch always forces fresh bootstrap and blocks writes.
Expired CI/research evidence is not shown as current PASS.
No duplicate memory/research engine/state store.
Metrics record API/read count, full-file count and cache-hit rate; tests do not depend on network timing.
findings.limitation: Optimizes repository read/audit/context-resume work; cannot guarantee ChatGPT UI rendering, browser navigation or model service latency.
findings.notes: Full bootstrap sequence, manifest fields, invalidation and performance rules are in fast_resume_and_audit_performance_contract.

rules: Classify HTTP status, response body and available permission/rate-limit headers.
403 permission denial: zero blind retries. Diagnose integration permission/repo access; then authorized owner action or pre-approved PowerShell/GitHub web route.

404: private resource can be masked by missing access; verify auth identity, owner/repo, exact branch/ref/path casing, parent directory, URL encoding and endpoint method. Never silently switch branches.
Rate limits: respect Retry-After and X-RateLimit-Reset. Without Retry-After for secondary limit, wait at least 60 seconds, then bounded backoff. Stop after bounded attempts.
Mutating requests are sequential. On stale SHA/409/422, read latest version and reconcile; no guessed SHA or force-overwrite.
Transient timeout/5xx may use bounded exponential backoff+jitter. Preserve the prepared file.
Log no secrets, tokens, passwords or authorization headers.
SAVED requires exact branch/path readback and confirmed blob/commit evidence.
not_allowed: Use another account/token without explicit authorization
Force push merely to remove a conflict

existing_layer_composition.T14: Repository context and resume manifest validation
existing_layer_composition.T16: Canonical repository/dependency graph and delta impact

fast_resume_steps: Fresh-read live branch HEAD and canonical state.json; parse current task only from live state.
Read manifest and validate repository, branch, state blob SHA, audit base commit, audited path blob SHAs and evidence freshness.
If fresh, read files needed by the current authorized subtask plus changed files/downstream dependents from T16 graph.
Reuse evidence only while provenance/freshness remains valid. Output a compact resume packet: active task, last exact PASS evidence, reviewed paths, open findings, blocker, next authorized action.
Run full audit only if explicitly requested or manifest missing/stale, state/authority mismatch, relevant high-risk changes, graph/architecture changes or required evidence expiry.
invalidation: Any state.json change requires current state parse and invalidates execution-relevant cache.
Unknown/mismatched hashes => STALE; never silently accept.
Manifest cannot authorize write, change task, override state.json or claim PASS.
If stale, scan changed paths plus transitive dependents; full scan only when scope cannot be bounded or risk requires it.
efficiency: Use compare/diff and changed paths rather than full tree rereads.
Use conditional requests/ETags where the authorized client supports them.
No repeated queries when valid results are already cached; refresh current/volatile information.
Keep first resume report short and useful; full findings on demand.
Do not parallelize writes; avoid rate-limit-amplifying request fan-out.
Measure request/read count, full files inspected, cache hit rate and actual time; do not promise unmeasured speed.
fast_resume_and_audit_performance_contra.limitation: Optimizes repository research/audit/context work after resume, not the ChatGPT screen-rendering/network latency.
